description: Using Multiecuscan diagnostic software, perform a live data monitoring and export session on an Alfa Romeo MiTo. In simulation mode: (1) Navigate to the correct vehicle (Alfa Romeo > MiTo) and select an engine control module, (2) Start simulation, (3) Navigate to the parameters view, (4) Select at least 4 parameters including RPM, coolant temperature, battery voltage, and throttle position, (5) Observe the simulated live data values, (6) Navigate to the graph view to visualize the parameters, (7) Create a parameter analysis report at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MultiecuscanTasks\parameter_analysis.txt that includes: the selected parameter names and their observed values, minimum/maximum/average estimates from the observed data, comparison against normal operating ranges (use obd2_parameter_reference.csv), and an assessment of whether each parameter is within normal bounds. Also reference the OBD-II session log data provided in the MultiecuscanData folder (real_obd_drive_session.csv) to compare simulation values against real-world recorded values.
natural_language: Monitor engine parameters on an Alfa Romeo MiTo in Multiecuscan simulation mode, view the graph, and create an analysis report comparing readings to normal ranges and real-world OBD data.
